rules.answer: The foreman reported the excavator in Zone B, without naming it [1]. The equipment register assigns EX-02 (GroundWorks) to EXC-B on 10 November [2], so EX-02 is inferred, not stated.
The mechanic expects EX-02 back at noon on 11 November. This is the mechanic's estimate, not a confirmed release [1].

On 10 November the signed report records 65 m³ for Excavation Zone B against a plan of 100 m³ [1]. The diary estimate earlier that afternoon was 70 m³ (provisional) [2]; the signed figure is the one used for alerts.
GroundWorks agreed to give Sam a backup excavator plan by 10 November at 12:00 [1]. On 8 November it was still outstanding [2].
Foundations Zone B is scheduled to start on 12 November after the Zone B excavation [1]. The client asked for confirmation that the handover still stands after the 10 November shift [2].
